notes: Counts are observations, not independent trades or daily profit. Sampling gaps cannot establish opportunity duration.
Uniswap legs sharing a pool are indicative_overlap; positive rows require combined simulation before profitability conclusions.
Historical event permissions and upgrades are not reconstructed; raw events and full receipts are retained. No historical executable-opportunity count.
Net values, when supplied, subtract an explicit assumed transaction gas budget only. USDT capital conversion, hedge, MEV and inclusion costs remain unevaluated.
